name: Inverse Volume Exploration
definition: A technique to approximate a desired rendering setting (viewpoint, color, opacity, light direction/magnitude) from a single reference image by optimizing transformation parameters of a pre-trained composed iVR-GS model, enabling novel view synthesis (NVS) under those learned settings without access to original volume data.
summary: Inverse Volume Exploration automatically optimizes transformation parameters to replicate a reference image's visual effect, avoiding manual trial-and-error adjustments required by base 3D Gaussian Splatting.
